title: Keep Walking
brief:
That is a long way to walk, and writing right() eleven times is nobody's idea of a good time. A while loop repeats a block of code for as long as its condition stays True:

while flags_left() > 0:
    right()

flags_left() reports how many flags are still uncollected. The moment you collect the last one it becomes 0, the condition turns False, and the loop stops.

The indented lines under while are the body — the part that repeats.
